blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Thursday raised concerns on the forthcoming increase in Meralco’s electricity rates amid a surge in inflation. Meralco recently announced that electricity rates in October will be at P15.0615 per kilowatt-hour (kWh), which is a P0.3191 per kWh increase from September’s P14.7424 per kWh, citing elevated fuel costs. The Philippine Statistics Authority also recorded a year-high rise in inflation at 7.2 percent in September. “Nakakagulat, dahil ang ating consumers right now, ang ating mga kababayan, hirap na hirap na sa pagbayad ng mataas na presyo ng bilihin lalo na ng bigas… Ngayon after tumaas […]...
